purpose: Golden prompt set for ReMCP tool-selection regression testing in ChatGPT Developer mode. Record actual selected tools and compare with expected sequences before releases.

cases.prompt: On my paired laptop, use the native accessibility tree to inspect the active app before doing anything.
cases.rationale: Native semantic inspection should precede pixels or coordinates.

cases.prompt: Use ReMCP browser DOM tools to find the Save button in the open Chromium page and click it, then wait until Saved appears.
cases.rationale: Known web-page task should stay in CDP/DOM and use semantic wait.

cases.prompt: Type this exact Unicode text into the focused editor on my laptop: Zażółć gęślą jaźń 👋
cases.rationale: Normal Unicode prose belongs to type_text, not key-by-key shortcuts.

cases.prompt: On my paired computer press Ctrl+L, then Escape.
cases.rationale: Shortcuts and control keys belong to keyboard.

cases.prompt: Click exactly at screen coordinates 640, 420 on my paired computer.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly requested a coordinate action.

cases.prompt: Drag the accessible item named Report.pdf onto the accessible folder named Archive.
cases.rationale: Semantic drag endpoints are more stable than coordinate mouse choreography.

cases.prompt: Find the Chrome window on my paired laptop and maximize it.
cases.rationale: Window operations should use window ids rather than desktop coordinates.

cases.prompt: Open https://example.com as a new debuggable Chrome tab through ReMCP.
cases.rationale: new_tab bootstraps CDP even when no page target exists.

cases.prompt: Read README.md from my paired computer, summarize it, then show the interactive file preview.
cases.rationale: Data-first read should precede the presentation-only renderer.

cases.prompt: Take a screenshot of my paired computer and show it in the interactive image viewer.
cases.rationale: Image capture stays data-first; the render tool only presents returned bytes.

cases.prompt: Run npm test on my paired laptop and then show the terminal output in the interactive terminal viewer.
cases.rationale: The command runs once; the renderer uses cached output and must not rerun it.

cases.prompt: What is open on my laptop right now, and what can I interact with?
cases.rationale: An unfamiliar mixed desktop state is the intended computer_snapshot use case.

cases.prompt: Open the Settings app on my laptop, find the Bluetooth switch, turn it on, and tell me when it is enabled.
cases.rationale: Native app semantics should drive the task end to end.

cases.prompt: In the open browser page, put Anton in the Name field, choose Poland, submit, and wait for the confirmation message.
cases.rationale: Page content should stay in DOM/CDP when available.

cases.prompt: Click the native Export button and continue only after the Export complete text appears.
cases.rationale: Semantic wait is preferred to sleeps or screenshot polling.

cases.prompt: After fixing the visible layout, verify that the final card is not clipped on screen.
cases.rationale: Static pixel/layout proof belongs to a targeted screenshot.

cases.prompt: The menu animation jitters during opening. Capture a short recording so we can debug the timing.
cases.rationale: Motion/timing debugging requires recording, not a static image.

cases.prompt: Tell me the values and formulas in Sheet1 of budget.xlsx on my paired computer without opening Excel.
cases.rationale: Structured document content should not drive a GUI app.

cases.prompt: Change B2 in budget.xlsx to 1250 and set C2 to =B2*1.23, then verify the cells.
cases.rationale: Direct XLSX editing is deterministic and should be read back.

cases.prompt: Extract pages 2 through 4 from report.pdf into report-excerpt.pdf.
cases.rationale: PDF structure operation should use pdf_action.

cases.prompt: Check whether nginx is running on my server and restart it if it is unhealthy.
cases.rationale: Service-manager operations should use the service tool.

cases.prompt: From my paired server, check whether db.internal.example on TCP port 5432 is reachable.
cases.rationale: Bounded connectivity test is structured and safer than shell networking commands.

cases.prompt: On the current debug page, return the value of window.__APP_BUILD__ which is not exposed in the DOM.
cases.rationale: browser_evaluate is justified only because supported DOM tools cannot expose the JS-only value.

cases.prompt: What is the weather in Rzeszów tomorrow?
cases.rationale: Use the platform weather capability; ReMCP is unrelated.

cases.prompt: Search the web for the latest OpenAI plugin documentation.
cases.rationale: General web research should use web search, not a user's paired computer.

cases.prompt: Summarize the paragraph I pasted above.
cases.rationale: The conversation already contains the data.

cases.prompt: Generate a watercolor illustration of a lighthouse.
cases.rationale: Image generation is a platform capability, not remote computer control.

cases.prompt: Remind me tomorrow at 9 AM to call the dentist.
cases.rationale: A future reminder is not a native notification on a paired device.

cases.prompt: What is 17% of 840?
cases.rationale: Simple arithmetic should not invoke a remote machine.
